verses.text: A prayer of the prophet Habakkuk, set to victorious music.
LORD, I have heard of your fame. I stand in awe of your works, LORD. Renew them in our time; make them known again. In your anger, remember mercy.
God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.
His brightness was like sunlight. Rays flashed from his hand, where his power was hidden.
Plague went ahead of him, and pestilence followed close behind.
He stood, and the earth shook. He looked, and nations trembled. The ancient mountains crumbled; the old hills collapsed. His ways last forever.
I saw the tents of Cushan in distress; the homes in Midian’s land trembled.
LORD, were you angry with the rivers? Was your anger against the rivers, or your fury against the sea, when you rode out on your horses and chariots of salvation?
You uncovered your bow and called for your sworn arrows. Selah. You split the earth with rivers.
The mountains saw you and shook. Floods swept past; the deep roared and lifted its hands high.
The sun and moon stood still in the sky at the flash of your arrows and the gleam of your shining spear.
You marched through the earth in anger and threshed the nations in fury.
You came to save your people, to save your anointed one. You crushed the leader of the wicked house and stripped him bare from head to foot. Selah.
You pierced the heads of his warriors with their own spears. They charged like a whirlwind to scatter me, celebrating as they secretly devoured the poor.
You trampled the sea with your horses, churning the mighty waters.
I heard, and my body shook. My lips quivered at the sound. My bones felt rotten, and I trembled where I stood. I will wait quietly for the day of trouble, when the people attacking us come.

Even if the fig tree doesn’t blossom and the vines have no grapes; even if the olive crop fails and the fields produce no food; even if the flocks disappear from the pens and there are no cattle in the stalls,
I will still rejoice in the LORD and celebrate the God who saves me!
The Lord GOD is my strength. He makes my feet like a deer’s and helps me walk on high places. For the music director, with my stringed instruments.
